observations.behavior: Adds a test class and two async tests, including a seeded non-nullable table and a batch carrying nulls, asserting that the fallback path raises a reset signal while the deltalite path does not.
observations.posthog_connection: Checks warehouse ingestion correctness: the fallback path must raise a reset signal when a batch carries nulls into a non-nullable column, while the deltalite path must not raise. This guards against silent corruption when deltalite is off.

observations.behavior: Removes a blanket raise of the reset signal before the merge, and adds a conditional raise only when deltalite did not write.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes warehouse ingestion behavior: the reset signal is no longer raised unconditionally before the merge, and is only raised after deltalite, guarding the fallback path. This could prevent unnecessary resets while still catching the dangerous fallback case.

observations.behavior: Adds a conditional raise of the reset signal only when deltalite did not write, guarding the fallback path.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes warehouse ingestion behavior: the reset signal is raised only when deltalite did not write, guarding the fallback path. This could prevent unnecessary resets while still catching the dangerous fallback case.
